Community Choir (drop-in)

Saturday 3 October 2026, 7:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End QLD 4101

No auditions and no need to read music. Songs are taught by ear in three parts; tea afterwards. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights.

$5. Doors open thirty minutes before the listed time. The hall is wheelchair accessible from the Example Street entrance.
